newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES END UP DISCOUNTING STRONG GOVT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES END UP DISCOUNTING STRONG GOVT.

text.p: Greek equities continued their advance closing with 0.80 percent gains on strong buying interest for blue chips and other stocks with good valuations as more investors see a strong government emerging from the national elections.

"Buying interest, especially for blue chips and other stocks with good valuations, drove the benchmark index higher as more investors are convinced that a majority government will emerge from the elections," said Apostolos Constandinidis, fund manager at Hambros Hellenic Mutual Funds.
Greece will hold early elections September 22.

The Athens general share index closed 0.80 percent, or 7.47 points higher at 938.60 from Tuesday's 931.13 close after opening at 930.97 points. Turnover rose to 9.21 billion drachmas on volume of 5.36 million shares.

"I expect the upward course to continue next week as local and foreign funds go hunting for oversold stocks, especially export-oriented companies," said Constandinidis. "Attractive share prices and growth prospects provide a positive backdrop."
There were a few block trades with 117,885 shares of Pavlidis changing hands at 676 drachmas, 130,000 shares of Viohalko at 3,415 drachmas and 100,000 shares of Alte at 3,400 drachmas.

Advancers led decliners 155 to 57 with 30 issues unchanged on 242 traded. Banks closed up 0.91 percent, industrials advanced 0.85 percent and construction gained 1.41 percent. Small-caps increased 0.27 percent.
The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 558-576 at the close. Shares of OTE telecom, the underlying, ended higher 10 drachmas at 4,045.

The recently launched Merrill Lynch stock index call warrant based on a basket of 23 shares was quoted at 199.80-210.30 drachmas. It expires on January 9 1998 with a strike price of 1000. It was in the money at 1027.4.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted at 3,789-4,017 drachmas at the close. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
